verdict.rationale: three.js is a code-first JavaScript library distributed via npm and driven directly from code, with the editor optional, so an editor is never required and builds can run through standard JS tooling. The evidence never documents a first-party build or export command, CI recipe, or headless rendering, so scripted CI builds are implied rather than shown. Missing for 10: documented CLI build/export workflow, headless (no-GPU/no-browser) rendering or export in CI, and independent hands-on CI corroboration.
